def transform(grid):
    sep = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if all(x == 0 for x in row))
    top, bottom = grid[:sep], grid[sep+1:]
    common = set(x for row in top for x in row) & set(x for row in bottom for x in row)
    color = next(iter(common))
    return [[3 if top[r][c] == color and bottom[r][c] == color else color for c in range(len(top[0]))] for r in range(len(top))]
